# karoo-ext-testing

> Test doubles for the Karoo system side of karoo-ext. They let a Karoo extension be tested on the JVM with Robolectric, and on an emulator without a Karoo, by standing in for the `KarooSystemService` the extension binds to. Test and debug tooling only: do not ship these artifacts in a release APK. The API is pre-1.0 and may still change.

The library is Kotlin and published as three artifacts under the group `com.github.nikosavola.karoo-ext-testing`: `karoo-ext-testing` (the fakes, `FakeKarooSystem` and `FakeKarooHost`), `karoo-ext-testing-robolectric` (`FakeKarooRule`, `FakeKarooBinding`, the fake BLE peripheral and `FakeAndroidKeyStore`) and `karoo-ext-testing-appstore` (an Android library for emulator tests). Releases are served from JitPack and GitHub Packages, see the tags on GitHub for the latest version. The Karoo itself, ANT+ hardware and real device behavior are not simulated.

## Documentation

- [Testing guide](https://nikosavola.github.io/karoo-ext-testing/testing-guide.md): recipes for binding a real extension service, driving sensor streams, HTTP sequences and failure paths, BLE devices, FIT, device and bonus outputs, cleanup assertions and time
- [Robolectric module](https://nikosavola.github.io/karoo-ext-testing/robolectric.md): FakeKarooRule, FakeKarooBinding, RobolectricPump, FakeBle and FakeAndroidKeyStore
- [Appstore module](https://nikosavola.github.io/karoo-ext-testing/appstore.md): the `io.hammerhead.appstore` stand-in for emulator tests
- [README](https://github.com/nikosavola/karoo-ext-testing/blob/main/README.md): install, requirements, a Robolectric quick start and a BLE example

## API reference

- [karoo-ext-testing](https://nikosavola.github.io/karoo-ext-testing/testing/index.html): FakeKarooSystem, FakeKarooHost, recorders, HTTP responders, SensorPoints, polyline helpers
- [karoo-ext-testing-robolectric](https://nikosavola.github.io/karoo-ext-testing/robolectric/index.html): FakeKarooRule, FakeKarooBinding, RobolectricPump, FakeBle, FakeBlePeripheral, FakeAndroidKeyStore
- [karoo-ext-testing-appstore](https://nikosavola.github.io/karoo-ext-testing/appstore/index.html): the AppStoreService stand-in and the FakeKaroo singleton
